summary: One-off vendor eval: 30 temporary SaaS seats + SCIM/SSO provisioning and cost-center routing
description:
Issue summary:
Research Platform requests a 6-week evaluation with a vector DB vendor (VectraSearch Inc.) that requires 30 user seats, SCIM provisioning, and Okta SSO integration. The request needs procurement to provision seats under a temporary procurement path, route charges to POC cost center 'RD-POC-2026', and enable SCIM-based group sync with mappings for 'research', 'ml-infra', and 'data-access'.

Impact:
- Research Platform cannot run cross-team POC without vendor access; delays will stall model indexing experiments scheduled for late March.
- Team needs SCIM to avoid manual invites (30 seats + expected churn).

Requirements:
1) Procure 30 temporary seats for 6 weeks (vendor invoice model: monthly, payable net-30).
2) Billing: route to cost center RD-POC-2026; if vendor requires a PO, raise PO referencing POC budget.
3) SCIM: enable provisioning, create group mappings and attributes: email, displayName, manager, department.
4) SSO: configure Okta OIDC/SCIM connector; provide metadata URL and ACS for vendor; ensure JIT disabled until SCIM sync validated.
5) Security: complete minimal vendor security intake (security questionnaire link provided) and ensure no production data is allowed in the POC index.

Background/context:
- Request originated from Research Platform (Anika Patel) after vendor demo on 2026-03-08.
- Vendor requires a named admin account and SCIM integration for automated invites.
- Finance prefers centralized billing for temporary POCs via existing POC cost centers where possible.

Steps taken so far:
- Research Platform submitted initial vendor profile to procurement (2026-03-09).
- Security team completed quick intake (security flagged data residency question; vendor hosts in us-west only).
- Legal asked for commercial terms and a standard MSA; vendor sent a SaaS addendum that legal is reviewing.

Blockers/ask from assignee:
- Procurement needs vendor W-9 and completed vendor-form (still pending).
- Finance asks whether vendor requires PO on first invoice; procurement to confirm.
- Identity/IT needs vendor SCIM endpoint and Okta app configuration info from the vendor to proceed with SSO/SCIM setup.

Acceptance criteria:
- 30 seats provisioned and accessible to invited users within 7 business days after vendor onboarding completion.
- SCIM group sync running daily with correct mappings for the target groups.
- Billing charged to RD-POC-2026 and/or PO created accordingly.
- Security sign-off on allowed POC data handling and region constraints.
comments: 2026-03-10 | Maya Chen (Reporter): Opening ticket per Anika's request. Attached vendor profile and initial cost estimation from vendor (~$3,600/month for 30 seats). Requesting procurement + identity assistance.

2026-03-10 | Procurement (Priya Ram): Thanks Maya — vendor W-9 requested. Can you ask vendor to confirm whether they require a PO on first invoice? Also share the billing email to route invoice to finance.

2026-03-11 | Anika Patel (Research Platform): Vendor confirmed they accept invoices without PO but will accept PO if provided. Billing email: finance+vendors@redwood.ai. Vendor SCIM docs: https://vendor.docs/vectrasearch/scim. Okta metadata URL sent in private.

2026-03-11 | Security (Jonas Meyer): Quick intake done. Main note: vendor only in us-west; no production PHI/data allowed in test indexes. Security approves conditional onboarding pending legal review of SaaS addendum.

2026-03-11 | Finance (Lina Torres): Finance can route to RD-POC-2026. If procurement generates a PO, please include cost center and approver. We will accept invoice to finance+vendors@redwood.ai. Please confirm if vendor needs tax forms for international invoicing.

2026-03-12 | Ethan Brooks (Assignee): Created vendor profile in Ariba; W-9 still outstanding — procurement emailed vendor a follow-up. Identity team to wait for SCIM credentials in secure vault before starting provisioning. Planning to provision 10 admin-named invites first for smoke test.
2026-03-12 | Legal (Rachel Kim): Reviewing vendor SaaS addendum; no major terms flagged yet but we need confirmation on data subprocessing and liability caps. ETA for review: 48 hours.
investigation: Procurement checked vendor authority and existing relationship history — no prior contracts found in Ariba.
Security validated region (us-west) and recommended restricting test dataset to synthetic data only.
Identity confirmed Okta can support SCIM provisioning for this vendor; risk is manual interim invites if SCIM delayed.
resolution: Pending. Next steps: procurement to secure W-9 and finalize vendor record; legal to complete addendum review; identity to perform SCIM smoke test once credentials are in vault; finance to confirm PO vs invoice routing. Target to have seats available by 2026-03-20 if vendor and legal timelines are met.
